clue.text: Arboreal wood-carver ?

definitions.meaning: tree-dwelling, describing apes that swing through forest canopies (a noun use: the tree-dwellers)
Grinling ... was a celebrated seventeenth-century English carver of wood

explanation.definitionFit: Tree-dwelling apes of Asia bear the name, as did England's most famous woodcarver, Grinling.

clue.text: Upright ones often parties to confidences

definitions.text: Upright ones often parties to confidences

parts.words: Upright ones often parties to confidences
parts.note: neighbours swap gossip leaning over the garden gate, so the posts holding it are present at their secrets

explanation.definitionFit: Upright posts holding a gate, beside which neighbours traditionally gossip.

clue.text: Bird strung up on festive occasions

definitions.meaning: flags and streamers hung out for celebrations

explanation.definitionFit: A family of songbirds, and festive flags and streamers hung on strings.

clue.text: Unusually short race for sound performers

indicators.note: unusually suggests the letters appear in an unusual order

explanation.surface: An unusually short race is held for healthy athletes.
explanation.walkthrough: SHORTRACE rearranged gives the answer; 'sound' is musical, not healthy.
explanation.definitionFit: Musicians who produce sound together in a large ensemble.

clue.text: Container for wine?

definitions.meaning: an old name for sherry and similar white wines

explanation.definitionFit: A large bag, and an old term for fortified white wine like sherry.

definitions.text: How a sneak-thief, say, might acquire this dog

parts.words: How a sneak-thief, say, might acquire this dog
parts.note: to whip is slang for to steal, so a thief would whip a pet, and that phrase run together names a slim racing breed

explanation.definitionFit: A slender racing breed of hound, whose name splits into a slang verb for steal plus an animal companion.

clue.text: William's price for his literary work?

definitions.text: William's price for his literary work?

parts.words: William's price for his literary work?
parts.note: the value of the poet William's writing would be counted by the worth of its words

explanation.definitionFit: William Wordsworth, the Romantic poet, whose surname splits into what his writing is worth.

clue.text: Angry because of no tax differential

definitions.text: Angry because of no tax differential

parts.words: Angry because of no tax differential
parts.note: a rate is a local tax, and ratepayers are cross when charges are not graded

explanation.definitionFit: Furious; the word holds a rate, the old British local tax.

clue.text: He sets out to make a good impression

definitions.text: He sets out to make a good impression

parts.words: He sets out to make a good impression
parts.note: sets type and makes impressions on paper, rather than wanting to be liked

explanation.definitionFit: A tradesman who sets type and presses it onto paper.

clue.text: "They kept the noiseless — of their way" (Gray)

definitions.text: "They kept the noiseless — of their way" (Gray)

parts.words: "They kept the noiseless — of their way" (Gray)
parts.note: a line from Thomas Gray's Elegy Written in a Country Churchyard with one word missing, meaning course

explanation.walkthrough: The missing word in Gray's Elegy line means general course or drift.
explanation.definitionFit: The word filling Gray's line means steady course.

clue.text: Coat cut in a new style

indicators.note: putting the letters into a new style rearranges them into another word

explanation.surface: A coat has been tailored in a fashionable modern cut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a new style' looks like tailoring talk, but 'in' belongs to the fodder: CUT IN rearranged gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A tunic is a close-fitting jacket, especially as part of a uniform.

clue.text: Mobile community in the pink?

parts.note: an automobile is a car, so the mobile part is the motor
a nation is a community of people

explanation.surface: A travelling community is said to be thriving and in good health.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the pink' means healthy; here 'the pink' is a garden flower of the dianthus family.
explanation.definitionFit: Pinks and carnations are close relatives in the dianthus family of garden flowers.

clue.text: Formed into company, proverbially

parts.note: the proverb says two's company, so making a couple forms a company

explanation.definitionFit: Grouped in twos; the saying 'two's company' makes a couple into a company.

clue.text: Sleeping Beauty before and after the kiss?

definitions.text: Sleeping Beauty before and after the kiss?

parts.words: Sleeping Beauty before and after the kiss?
parts.note: before the prince's kiss she is held by an enchantment, and after it she is entranced by love

explanation.definitionFit: Held by an enchantment, as the fairy-tale princess was, or entranced.

clue.text: In this sense enlightenment

parts.note: vision is one of the five senses, and putting the word 'in' before it gives a word for understanding

explanation.definitionFit: Vision is one of the five senses; preceded by 'in' it gives a word for deep understanding.

clue.text: The character of sound

parts.note: a written character or symbol that stands for a spoken sound, rather than the quality of a noise

explanation.definitionFit: A written symbol representing a spoken sound, as in shorthand.

clue.text: Go too far and fire too many

definitions.meaning: to pass beyond a target or limit
to shoot more game than allowed

explanation.definitionFit: Passing beyond the mark, and shooting more game than a moor can sustain.

clue.text: As versatile as the Football League

definitions.meaning: the League is made up of many teams or sides

explanation.definitionFit: Having many facets, and literally a League of many teams.

clue.text: Minor water supply in a way — a millilitre

indicators.note: the letters for the millilitre and article go in the middle of the road word

parts.note: a street is a way or road

explanation.surface: A small water supply comes through the road, only a tiny amount.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a way' reads as 'in a manner', but 'in' is the container signal and 'way' is the road the other letters go into.
explanation.definitionFit: A small stream, a minor flow of water.

clue.text: Makes another 26 and gives up

definitions.meaning: signs again, writing another autograph (26 across)

explanation.definitionFit: Hyphenated it means signs once more; as one word it means quits a post.

clue.text: Old king wined, becoming fuddled

indicators.note: fuddled means muddled by drink, so the letters get mixed up

explanation.surface: An ancient monarch, having been wined, ends up tipsy.
explanation.definitionFit: Edwin was a seventh-century king of Northumbria.

clue.text: One such dealer being a stop-me-and-buy-one trader?

definitions.text: One such dealer being a stop-me-and-buy-one trader?

parts.words: One such dealer being a stop-me-and-buy-one trader?
parts.note: a ...-dealer is a sharp trader, and the old ice-cream seller rode a tricycle saying stop me and buy one

explanation.walkthrough: 'Stop me and buy one' was the slogan on Walls ice-cream tricycles in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: The ice-cream vendor on a tricycle, completing the phrase for a shrewd dealer.

clue.text: Trial pipe may help to produce a solution

definitions.text: may help to produce a solution

parts.note: a test is a trial
a tube is a pipe

clue.text: Work for undertakers

parts.note: suggests funeral directors, but means jobs taken on by those who undertake them

explanation.definitionFit: Jobs or duties that people take on.

clue.text: Such winds of 'change?

parts.note: steady tropical winds share their name with exchange of goods; 'change is short for exchange

explanation.definitionFit: The steady tropical winds, and a word for exchange or commerce.

clue.text: Their purpose is to put you in your place

definitions.text: Their purpose is to put you in your place

parts.words: Their purpose is to put you in your place
parts.note: reads like people who humble you, but means those who show you to your seat in a theatre or church

explanation.definitionFit: Attendants show guests to their seats at weddings, theatres and churches.

clue.text: Sounds as if there's this goddess in the audience

indicators.note: the clue says the goddess's name has the sound of another word

parts.note: one in an audience is a listener, a hearer

explanation.surface: It seems a goddess is sitting in the theatre audience.
explanation.definitionFit: Queen of the Greek gods, wife of Zeus.

clue.text: Rag tune is perhaps written on a dotted line

indicators.note: perhaps suggests the letters might be arranged some other way

explanation.surface: A ragtime tune is apparently written down on dotted staves.
explanation.definitionFit: One's name is signed on the dotted line of a document.

clue.text: Big dictionary includes the Italian for " drunk"

indicators.note: the dictionary takes the article into itself

parts.note: OED is the Oxford English Dictionary
il is Italian for 'the'

explanation.walkthrough: The scan reads 'the Italian', which the newspaper text misread as 'in the Italian'.

clue.text: Defer order for hanging?

definitions.meaning: to defer is to put off till later
an instruction to hang something up, as a lamp from a ceiling

clue.text: The case of Jonson is thus related

definitions.text: The case of Jonson is thus related

parts.words: The case of Jonson is thus related
parts.note: Ben Jonson spelt his name differently from the usual Johnson, and the word 'related' itself is a rearrangement of the required word
